features.description: Parent ownership and atomic child fences
acceptance_criteria: Two DB connections racing identical/different work IDs produce one active mission admission.
Parent cancellation and lease loss fence child start and accept-and-advance transactionally.
Quota-blocked prepared attempts resume same request without terminalizing or replacing work.

acceptance_criteria: Clean committed work is recognized; ancestry/scope/required artifacts are verified from Git.

Wrong revision, changed authority, failed hard checks, mutated candidate or stale judge fails.

features.notes: Strict Git/protocol/authority and isolated bounded verification pass, including decision evidence and aggregate output bound; exact actual route determines evaluation independence.

acceptance_criteria: Sequential remaining stages dispatch once, with immutable inputs and persisted acceptance.
Crash tests cover before/after dispatch, DB/receipt disagreement and acceptance-before-next.
No fallback/retry after execution starts; completed role is validated without another call.

Iteration/stage deadlines and remaining budgets survive restart and cannot reset on resume.
Lost parent with live child waits; ambiguity is preserved and never auto-reclaimed.
features.notes: Sequential Service, durable stage/iteration deadlines, expired prepared cleanup and ambiguous running retention, real abrupt crash boundaries, actual adapter descendant termination and final usage validation. Focused integration and race suites green; shared standalone orchestration extracted from CLI.

features.description: CLI status and one-shot driver seam
acceptance_criteria: Status distinguishes running, waiting reasons, reconciliation, failure and validated completion.
Missing config/DB and changed inputs fail loudly without creating status-side state.

Repeated completed invocation returns the same evidence and zero extra provider calls.
CLI help and documented fixtures agree; Bash 3.2 compatibility tests pass.
features.notes: Strict CLI and binding, read-only redacted status with actual route and usage provenance, frozen resume/versioned cancel; actual driver foreign-cwd one-shot fixture and full Bash3.2 driver suite green.
